Title: Python RegEx
Description: A RegEx, or Regular Expression, is a sequence of characters that forms a search pattern.

Challenges.Title: Search
Challenges.Exercise: Use `re.search()` to see if 'rain' is in the string 'The rain in Spain'.

Challenges.Title: Findall
Challenges.Exercise: Use `re.findall()` to find all matches of 'ai' in the string.

Challenges.Title: Split
Challenges.Exercise: Use `re.split()` to split the string at every white-space character '\s'.

Challenges.Title: Sub
Challenges.Exercise: Use `re.sub()` to replace all white-space characters with the digit '9'.
